props.title: What Makes Traditional Thai Massage Unique?
props.text: Traditional Thai Massage is an ancient wellness technique that combines rhythmic pressure, assisted stretching, and controlled body movements to improve flexibility and ease physical tension. Unlike oil-based massage styles that focus mainly on flowing strokes, Thai Massage uses guided stretches and pressure points to encourage better mobility, body awareness, and overall relaxation.
props.feature1Text: Uses guided movements inspired by traditional Thai techniques to help improve flexibility.
props.feature2Text: Applies steady pressure to areas where stiffness and tension commonly build up.

props.title: Thai Massage Duration Options
props.text: Thai Massage combines assisted stretching with pressure techniques to support flexibility and ease areas that feel tight from daily movement or travel. Longer sessions allow more time to work through the body and spend extra attention on areas that need it most.

props.title: Why Do Guests Choose Thai Massage in Bali?
props.text: Thai Massage takes a more active approach than many traditional relaxation massages. Instead of relying mainly on flowing strokes, our treatment combines hands-on pressure with guided stretching to create a more dynamic experience. Guests may choose Thai Massage for reasons such as:
featuresLeft: Helps ease stiffness from daily activities
Relieves tension in commonly affected areas
featuresRight: Suitable after flights, travel, or physical activity
Combines massage with gentle stretching techniques
Ideal for guests who prefer a more active treatment style

props.title: Which Parts of the Body Are Treated During Thai Massage?
props.text: Thai Massage takes a full-body approach, with our therapist moving between different areas throughout the session. The focus can be adjusted according to your comfort and the parts of the body that need more attention. Common focus areas are:
featuresLeft: Back and shoulders affected by long sitting
Neck area with daily posture tension
Hips and legs needing more mobility
featuresRight: Arms and upper body after repetitive movement
Areas that feel stiff after exercise or travelling

props.title: How Does Traditional Thai Massage Work?
props.text: Traditional Thai Massage follows a structured approach that combines pressure and guided movement rather than continuous oil-based strokes. Our therapist works through the body at a steady pace, adapting the techniques throughout the session to create a comfortable balance between passive movement and relaxation. The treatment may involve:
featuresLeft: Uses hands, thumbs, palms, and elbows for pressure
Performed without oil for better control

items.question: What is Traditional Thai Massage?
items.answer: Traditional Thai Massage is a traditional bodywork technique that combines pressure, stretching, and movement. It focuses on improving body comfort, flexibility, and relaxation through structured techniques.

items.question: Is Thai Massage suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Beginners can enjoy Thai Massage as our therapists can adjust the intensity and stretching movements based on your comfort level.

items.question: What should I wear during a Thai Massage session?
items.answer: Wear comfortable clothing you can move in, because the treatment includes stretching and guided movements. Unlike oil massage, Thai Massage does not require direct skin contact for the entire session.

items.question: Is Thai Massage good after a long flight or travel?
items.answer: Yes. Many travellers choose Thai Massage after long journeys because the stretching techniques can help the body feel less restricted and more comfortable.

items.question: Is Thai Massage Dangerous?
items.answer: Thai massage is generally safe when performed by a trained therapist, but it may not be suitable for everyone. People with certain injuries, medical conditions, or recent surgeries should consult a healthcare professional before having a session.

items.question: Is Thai Massage Painful?
items.answer: Thai massage can feel firm or intense because it involves pressure and assisted stretching. It should not cause sharp or severe pain, and your therapist can adjust the pressure and movements to your comfort level.

items.question: Can I combine Thai Massage with other spa treatments?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests combine Thai Massage with facial, manicure, cream bath, or body treatments for a more complete spa experience.

items.question: How much does Thai massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: IDR 133.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 259.000 for 1 hour and IDR 379.000 for 1.5 hours per person at Spa Bali Moon. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist.

items.question: How long is a Thai massage?
items.answer: Sessions run 30 minutes, 1 hour or 1.5 hours. Thirty minutes suits tight spots when you're short of time; one hour or more covers the whole body.

items.question: Where can I get a Thai massage in Seminyak?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon offers it at our spa in Seminyak (Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30) and at your villa or hotel. Book on WhatsApp, 9am to 11pm.
